action_items: HIGH: Strip location.coords from /api/admin/users response (project only country/city/comuna). Currently admin JSON contains 'coordinates' array for every user which violates B#3 stated requirement.
OPTIONAL: server.py now >1600 lines - carve auth + profile + discover into routers/ subpackage for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /profile/me correctly gates location re-derivation on (body.location present) OR (comuna value CHANGED). Prevents the alias-only regression. Verified in both backend + frontend network capture.
build_location_doc applies round_coords(2 dp) uniformly. Good.
bucket_distance_km caps at 50 and floors at 5 with ceil-to-multiple-of-5 - matches the spec exactly.

validate_bio uses BIO_URL_RE that matches TLDs '.com/.cl/.net/.org/.io/.co' anywhere - could false-positive on words like 'incognito' due to '.co' word-boundary lookback; regex uses \b only on '.co' so 'incognito' would NOT match (safe). Slightly aggressive but acceptable.
BIO_PHONE_RE '(?:\+?\d[\s\-\.]?){6,}' will flag any 6-digit-with-separators sequence - fine for phones but could reject dates/ages combos. Documented risk.
clear_public() correctly hides coords and only surfaces distance_km when set - good.
/api/admin/users returns raw user docs including location.coords.coordinates - LEAK vs the B#3 spec. Suggest passing users through a project stage or admin-safe serializer that strips coords.

LocationPicker.jsx: onOutsideChile branch fires ONLY when pending country != CL after GPS reverseGeocode. The manual picker hard-codes country='CL' so no way to trigger waitlist gate from manual mode - probably intentional (only Chilean cities in dropdown), but worth documenting.
EditProfile.jsx: locationChanged flag correctly stays false until onChange fires. Verified via network capture.
Discover.jsx profile-distance text: '· a ~{n} km' or '· a 50+ km' - matches spec.
server.py has grown past 1500 LOC; splitting into routers is overdue.

rca_of_the_issue: For the admin/users leak: admin_list_users() does users.find(..., {password_hash:0, _id:0}).to_list() and returns raw docs. Since location.coords.coordinates lives inside the returned doc, admins see the (rounded) coordinates. Mitigation: add projection {'location.coords': 0} OR post-process to drop 'coords' from the location subdoc before returning. Impact: LOW risk (admin-only), but explicitly violates B#3 acceptance criterion in AJUSTESV2.md.
